name: Grande Centre Point Voyage Pattaya
detail: I was very impressed with the service and facilities of the hotel. It is suitable for families of all generations. The staff provided attentive service, and the breakfast restaurant was excellently managed, consistently replenishing the food line even with a large number of guests.

name: Sunday Beachfront View Jomtien Pattaya
detail: I like the location and can choose budget-friendly days on Agoda. If you come early, you often get a sea view room (recommended for level 5 and above). Room B 803 is a small room, so there is no large daybed and no balcony (rooms ending in 03, 04). Odd-numbered rooms have a sea view. The advantage is that you can enjoy the beautiful sea view from the bed. In the afternoon, the sun comes in, and sometimes the small air conditioner can't handle it. The bathroom shows signs of long-term use, which is acceptable. But be cautious of the slippery floor due to standing water, as some spots are not sloped towards the drain. The area around the swimming pool would be excellent if improved and well-maintained because the view is very beautiful. For breakfast, if the bread section could be improved in quality and offer more options, including jams and margarine, it would be greatly appreciated. In summary, I love the sea view, so I overlook other shortcomings.

name: Sunday Wongamat Privacy Pattaya
detail: The room is very large, 50 square meters, with a wide balcony. It's fairly clean for an old building. The bed is comfortable, the blanket is cozy, and the sheets are clean, but the pillowcases have a slightly musty smell. The bathroom has a bathtub separated from the shower area, and the water pressure is good with both hot and cold water available. There is a king size bed and a single bed in the room, along with one long sofa, which can comfortably accommodate up to 4 people per room. The staff are very nice, and my mother liked it a lot because the room is spacious. It’s an old room in an old building, but there's nothing scary about it. The atmosphere is good and suitable for relaxation.

name: Samsara Hotel Pattaya
detail: The staff is very helpful, the room is clean with a pleasant smell, and all the necessary equipment is provided. The pool on the upper floor is very beautiful and is a warm saltwater pool. There is a mini bar with snacks, coffee, and soft drinks available for free. The day I went was my birthday, and the hotel arranged a mini cake for me at no charge. The breakfast is delicious, and I highly recommend this place for anyone staying around Pattaya. The hotel is quite new and easily accessible.

name: Travelodge Pattaya
detail: There are plenty of restaurants and massage shops unique to Thailand that you can stroll to from the beach, which is very convenient. The staff is super kind. I ended up extending my stay and mistakenly booked two rooms, but they helped me with the cancellation in a caring way. After that, they would check in by saying things like We're waiting for a response now or It's okay~. 😊 The room cleaning varied quite a bit depending on the person… haha. Sometimes there was only a bath towel, or I was missing a hand towel. The cleaning around the bath wasn't great either. However, the staff's friendliness made it a pleasant experience. The light by the mirror is dim, so it might be a problem for those who like to do their makeup perfectly.

name: Nonze Hostel
detail: I thought of staying in Pattaya for one night with a light heart, and after searching for a comfortable and affordable place, I ended up here. Wait, there's a place like this above that McDonald's on Beach Road, which you must pass whenever you're heading to Pattaya's Walking Street? I was surprised, but once I arrived at the accommodation, I was captivated by the view of the sea from the dormitory room's window. It truly offers a location where you can overlook the sea that symbolizes Pattaya, which alone I think is worth a visit. The dormitory itself was spacious and comfortable, with plenty of showers and toilets, and the facilities were very clean. Above all, despite being right in the middle of Japan's summer vacation season, for some reason there were only a few guests, so it was very quiet and comfortable at night, which was a big win. If you're looking for a dormitory-type accommodation during your stay in Pattaya, I highly recommend this place without any reservations. Personally, it was one of the most satisfying dormitory accommodations I've ever stayed in.

name: The Bedroom Hostel Pattaya
detail: The hotel is located right in front of the beach with an excellent location. The restrooms are separated for men and women and there are several rooms available. The housekeeping cleans often. The bedrooms are good and worth the price. The air conditioning is cool and refreshing, and the beds are soft and comfortable. It's definitely a place I would return to.

name: Natural Beach Hotel
detail: The room is clean. Convenient for travel. There is basement parking. The alley is a bit narrow. The staff provide good service and are friendly. The room is spacious with a balcony. The bathroom is very clean. The water pressure is low, but not too much. Overall, it was very good. I would like to come back again! 🤩
area: Pattaya Beach Road,Pattaya - View on map

name: D Apartment 1
detail: I stayed for three nights and had a very comfortable experience. The room was spacious and clean, and I was able to relax a lot during my stay. The shower pressure was strong and I had no issues with hot water. The staff were cheerful and provided pleasant service. Right near the hotel, there are convenience stores like 7-Eleven and restaurants, so I had no trouble with shopping or meals. Since it is slightly away from the bustling city center, the area around the hotel was relatively calm and comfortable at night. If you have a room facing the road, you might hear sounds from motorcycles at night. For those sensitive to noise, having earplugs might be reassuring, but personally, I wasn't particularly bothered. The hotel itself was quiet. Considering the price, I was very satisfied, and it is a hotel I would like to use again when staying in Pattaya.

name: OZO North Pattaya
detail: The room is spacious and very clean, with a well-maintained bathroom. The cleaning service is excellent and the staff is friendly. The location is convenient for traveling and has a good wifi connection. The amenities are complete and it is worth the money paid.
